"""Launch one explicit verified V163 review continuation;no repeated scientific call."""
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V163-harmonic-phase-v1'
old=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json');assert not live(old['owner']) and not live(old['child_owner'])
assert read(root/'review-adoption-v2.json')['adopted_head_calls']==268
assert not (root/'review-continuation-launch-v2.json').exists()
with (root/'queue-controller-v2.log').open('x') as log:
    p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(repo/'.cache/queue-v163-review-v2.py')],cwd=repo,
        env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH='src:scripts',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1'),
        stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
    owner={'pid':p.pid,'created':psutil.Process(p.pid).create_time()}
save(root/'review-continuation-launch-v2.json',{'status':'explicit-verified-review-continuation-launched',
    'owner':owner,'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'adoption':ref(root/'review-adoption-v2.json'),
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print(owner)
